requiredOwnerDecision.description: Approve exactly one missingness strategy and its variable-level applicability without silent filling.

gates.allowedNextAction: Attach one independently reviewed owner-decision envelope for OWNER_MISSINGNESS_POLICY.
gates.prohibitedAuthorityInterpretation: Diagnostic strategy enumeration does not select a missingness policy or authorize imputation.

requiredOwnerDecision.description: Approve the archetype method, count, labels, and exact feature set as one versioned decision.

gates.allowedNextAction: Attach one independently reviewed owner-decision envelope for OWNER_ARCHETYPE_METHOD_COUNT_LABELS_FEATURE_SET after the missingness gate closes.
gates.prohibitedAuthorityInterpretation: The feature evidence register does not select features, archetypes, counts, or labels.

requiredGovernanceAuthorization.description: Explicitly authorize the scope and version of any fictional-country mapping step.

gates.allowedNextAction: Prepare an independent governance decision envelope; do not create a mapping or country record.
gates.prohibitedAuthorityInterpretation: A data-readiness pass cannot itself authorize fictional-country identity or generation.

requiredNewSourceOrCredential.description: Provide an authenticated WTO tariff retrieval with frozen raw bytes, snapshot metadata, normalization provenance, and independent review.

gates.allowedNextAction: Attach one reviewed new-source evidence envelope only after a credential is supplied out of band; never store the credential.
gates.prohibitedAuthorityInterpretation: The confirmed WTO gap is not tariff evidence and cannot be backfilled from another provider or synthetic values.

requiredNewSourceOrCredential.description: Provide at least two frozen distinct retrievals of the same canonical provider query with reviewable timestamps and byte hashes.

gates.allowedNextAction: Attach one reviewed repeated-snapshot evidence envelope when equivalent-query vintages exist.
gates.prohibitedAuthorityInterpretation: Multiple years, multiple different queries, or missing source-as-of metadata cannot support a vintage-stability claim.

requiredOwnerDecision.description: Approve one exhaustive sector-component taxonomy and one reporter/mirror treatment policy.

requiredNewSourceOrCredential.description: Provide frozen observations that cover the approved exhaustive sector components without manufacturing/industry double counting.

gates.allowedNextAction: Attach the owner-policy and reviewed sector-source envelopes; reconciliation remains a later separately authorized action.
gates.prohibitedAuthorityInterpretation: Partial sector sums and mirror differences are diagnostics, not totals, balanced trade, or IPF/RAS output.

requiredGovernanceAuthorization.description: Independently approve the exact closed-gate evidence target for non-runtime handoff review.

gates.allowedNextAction: After every dependency closes, attach one independent final-handoff authorization envelope and prepare a separate review candidate.
gates.prohibitedAuthorityInterpretation: Even a data-handoff readiness pass is not World Core import, runtime seed authority, V10.1 execution, or production approval.
